result.title: Leveraging Complementary Event Frame and Voxel Representations for RGB-Guided Multimodal Pre-training
result.summary: In this paper, we propose CM3AE 2.0, a unified RGB Frame and Event-Voxel/-Frame pre-training framework. By jointly learning multimodal spatiotemporal representations and exploiting latent cross-modal dependencies through cross-modal generation, the framework enhances multimodal information interaction and collaborative modeling capabilities. Specifically, we first propose an Event-aware Spatiotemporal Masked Reconstruction (ESMR) strategy to learn unified multimodal spatiotemporal representations. It leverages event responses to guide masking toward dynamically salient regions. Through spatiotemporal masked reconstruction, it learns spatial structures and their temporal variations from continuous RGB-Event observations. In addition, it incorporates multimodal fusion reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive learning to facilitate the modeling of cross-modal complementary information and the learning of shared representations. Building upon this, we further propose a Hierarchical Cross-modal Generation (HCG) strategy to learn latent cross-modal dependencies through visual and language generation. At the visual level, Event-conditioned RGB generation is performed using a pre-trained diffusion model to capture visual associations between the two modalities. At the language level, video-level text description generation based on joint RGB-Event representations establishes connections between multimodal visual features and linguistic semantics, further enriching the learning of cross-modal dependencies. Extensive experiments on four diverse downstream tasks demonstrate that CM3AE 2.0 consistently improves performance, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed pre-training framework.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CM3AE 2.0 的 RGB 帧与事件体素/事件帧统一预训练框架：以事件响应引导时空掩码重建，并结合多模态融合重建、跨模态对比以及基于扩散模型的 RGB 生成和视频级文本生成来学习跨模态依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 用事件响应引导掩码聚焦动态显著区域、并以跨模态生成约束共享表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容监督提供线索，但属预训练表示学习，与推理期状态生成的关联需核查。
